security_boundary.provider_constraints: Numeric repository, owner and actor IDs; main ref; workflow_dispatch; exact workflow path.

browser_dependency.supersede_condition: Actual authenticated server GET receipts satisfy exact retained context/timestamp/existence gate for each pair; then reconcile independently. No supersession from code/unit tests.

next_action.requires: Approve and provision the exact temporary database-level GET scope via dedicated GitHub OIDC Workload Identity Federation described in operations/feedback-read/access-plan.json. No key, Auth provider, Rules or privacy-policy change. This grants GET of known IDs in (default), not a document-level IAM allowlist. Operations executes only the ten retained synthetic feedback reads. No Work Google sign-in retry.

rollback: Revoke only new scoped binding or disable dedicated pool; remove verification workflow. No learner data or existing security bindings changed.
